versions.author: designer
versions.summary:
A court of wind folk whose units Gust: they make extra attacks out of turn, before and during the fight.
The last unit you played is Announced and gets the Court's buffs, so play order and seating become the puzzle each turn.

versions.author: reviser
versions.summary:
Settled the main rules gap: a Gust is an attack but not a normal attack, so Lady High Pressure, Old Föhn and the Thunderhead now read one way.
Föhn's forced Gusts no longer feed an enemy Gale engine and he gains Hunker; Fair-and-Foul and the Barometer Clerk now feed the Announced unit and the Gust count.

stop_reason: 3 of 3 reviewers said it's in a good spot
